nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What are the main factors contributing to groundwater salinization near the coastline according to Music et al. (2018)?
nodes.answer: The main factors contributing to groundwater salinization near the coastline are Na+, Cl?, Ca2+, NO3?, SO42?, As, and K+.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Sea level rise|Saltwater intrusion into freshwater aquifers_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How can a high SAR negatively affect water availability for crops, and what are the factors that contribute to this in the Roccamonfina area?
nodes.answer: A high SAR can negatively influence water availability for crops as both Na+ and Cl? Can generate negative growth responses in sensitive crops even at low concentrations, alongside the high rate of HCO3. In the Roccamonfina area, better quality for irrigation is characterized by the carbonate massif, while the HVP shows medium quality likely due to the presence of reworked CI materials and untreated sewer water.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Sea level rise|Saltwater intrusion into freshwater aquifers_qna_002
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What method was used to assess the vulnerability to seawater intrusion in the Volcano river mouth in Italy?
nodes.answer: The AUDIT-SUSI method was used to assess the vulnerability to seawater intrusion in the Volcano river mouth in Italy.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Sea level rise|Saltwater intrusion into freshwater aquifers_qna_003
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How can the AUDIT method be used for seawater intrusion vulnerability mapping of aquifers?
nodes.answer: The AUDIT method can be used for seawater intrusion vulnerability mapping of aquifers by analysing various parameters to assess the risk of intrusion and potential impacts.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Sea level rise|Saltwater intrusion into freshwater aquifers_qna_004
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the main focus of Mastrocicco and Colombian's 2021 review on groundwater salinization in coastal areas of the Mediterranean region?
nodes.answer: The main focus of Mastrocicco and Colombian's 2021 review is the issue of groundwater salinization in coastal areas of the Mediterranean region.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Sea level rise|Saltwater intrusion into freshwater aquifers_qna_005
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are the main risks associated with the ICUW as identified in the study?
nodes.answer: The ICUW is vulnerable to contamination from agricultural runoff, seawater intrusion, and geothermal water intrusion.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Sea level rise|Saltwater intrusion into freshwater aquifers_qna_006
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What percentage of the north-western Black Sea area was impacted by the dam breach?
nodes.answer: More than 50% of the area of the north-western Black Sea was impacted by the dam breach.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Sea level rise|Saltwater intrusion into freshwater aquifers_qna_007
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are the main environmental stressors affecting samphires and their habitats as identified in the document?
nodes.answer: The main environmental stressors affecting samphires and their habitats include drought, flooding, heat stress, wind, water extraction, secondary salinization, habitat fragmentation, and mining, all of which threaten the integrity of salt lake ecosystems.

nodes.question: What gap in knowledge is highlighted concerning water boundary conditions and their interactions with FTCs?
nodes.answer: There remains a notable gap in knowledge regarding the influence of water boundary conditions and their interactions with FTCs.
